name: Youth Outdoor Ambassador Program
what_you_do: A paid summer internship in the Forest Preserves. You pull invasive plants, care for animals, help at events and help naturalists run kids' nature camps. Weekly field trips show you green careers.
who_can_apply: Ages 16 to 22. You must be free for the whole summer, work a flexible schedule with weekends, and get yourself to sites around Cook County.
pay_detail: Paid internship. The page does not give the hourly pay.
duration: 10 weeks, June to August, up to 40 hours a week
deadline_text: Applications usually open in early February and are due by the end of March. The 2027 dates are not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Apply on the Forest Preserves of Cook County jobs page when the youth posting opens in February.
notes: The work is outdoors in all weather and can be hard on your body. The page says 10 weeks in one place and about 12 weeks between mid-June and early August in another, so check the posting. At the end you share what you learned at a ceremony for family and staff.
